justifications.D1: "This is a deliberate bet AGAINST the naive story ('more solved/failed examples make the judge smarter')" — the calibration-vs-discrimination failure mode is converted into falsifiers F2/F3 that would detect it (decoy-gap and survivorship-bias signature).
justifications.D3: "ΔAUC-ROC(FT-paired vs B-prompt) on E-near... does not exceed 0.03 AUC at the Holm-corrected 0.05 level" plus a fixed-length no-extension stopping rule — >=2 numeric falsifiers with an explicit stop, but no cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier.
justifications.D4: "B-prompt is the same exposure without the weight update" — each summary confound (format/template via typed decoys, prior via base-rate reporting, entity via lineage split) has a concrete element, but the signature-exists check is cited rather than specified as a runnable positive control.
justifications.D5: "the direct reason this design runs TWO training arms (pooled vs paired) rather than one" — acknowledges the near-duplicate precedent and states its new cell (matched-twin format and the near-vs-decoy gap).
justifications.D6: "declared underpowered rather than the bar lowered post hoc" and "reported as a pipeline exercise, not a decisive result" — every branch including vacuous/underpowered readings is pre-committed.

justifications.D1: "the calibrating kill generalizes past its original confounds and is a property of the archive/objective, not an artifact of the first experiment's hygiene gaps" — the prior failure is rebuilt as the experiment's own two-sided question with LOSO promoted to the primary gate.
justifications.D3: "the fine-tuned judge... must beat the heuristic floor... by >=5pp accuracy/AUC on at least 3 of 4... held-out sources" plus a frozen-manifest, one-pass stopping rule — numeric falsifiers with explicit stops, but no cheap early mechanism-independent kill.
justifications.D4: "reproducing the 0.228->0.908-style headline check but on hygiene-fixed data, to confirm the fix didn't kill the in-distribution signal outright" — every summary confound addressed concretely (de-templating, label balance, fitness manifest) plus an in-distribution signal-reachability check.
justifications.D5: "H1 confirmed closes the LLM-judge-from-raw-text approach on this archive with a cleaner methodology than the first kill; H0 confirmed reopens it with a concrete recipe" — an explicitly framed superseding rerun naming its new (hygiene-fixed) cell.
justifications.D6: "Any result landing between falsifiers 1 and 3... is reported as NOT_ESTABLISHED with both numbers shown side by side" — every branch pre-committed, including INVALIDATED-on-leak and LOSO-not-applicable downgrades.

justifications.D1: "Falsifier 2: If truncated-data AUC >= 0.68 (within 0.04 of full-data model), reject transfer-learning interpretation; model learned format, not structure" — the format failure mode cannot silently bite, though the prior-only decomposition arm is missing.
justifications.D3: "Falsifier 1: If fine-tuned AUC < 0.62 on held-out test, hypothesis rejected" plus a 3-seed stopping rule — >=2 numeric falsifiers with an explicit stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "Hold-out task family: ... AUC drop >0.10 signals overfitting to task-family-specific heuristics" — the summary's confounds each have concrete elements (truncated-data control, shuffled labels, ablation), but no positive control demonstrating detectability.
justifications.D5: "can learn to classify new attempts as success/failure with AUC > 0.70" — substantially re-asks the refuted fine-tune-a-judge question with defensible added controls, but never frames itself as superseding the prior kill.
justifications.D6: "If (B) achieves >75% accuracy but (A) < 65%, then outcome information is carrying the signal" — falsifier branches map to distinct conclusions, but no vacuous/no-signal reading (e.g., unusable archive) is pre-committed.

justifications.D1: "the observed gain is ~entirely format-following + outcome base-rate + value memorization... taken seriously because it is the modal outcome in this archive's own history" — the prior decomposition is rebuilt as mandatory Phase 3 with falsifier 3 gating success on the residual's CI excluding 0.
justifications.D3: "if fewer than 3 independent sources each yield >=100 usable triples with a solved:failed ratio between 20:80 and 80:20, the experiment HALTS at Phase 0" — a cheap, early, mechanism-independent falsifier plus Holm-corrected numeric falsifiers 2-5 and fixed stops.
justifications.D4: "genuine-judgment residual = raw gain − max(shuffled-label gain, format-only gain, base-rate-only gain)" — every summary confound isolated by a named control (decomposition battery, GroupKFold, two-sided leakage read), but no planted-signal positive control is concretely specified in the design.
justifications.D5: "relation/domain-disjoint transfer falsifier (anti-transfer check)... distinct from and in addition to entity-disjoint holdout" — an explicitly framed superseding rerun naming its new cells (this archive's structure, the relation-disjoint split).
justifications.D6: "reported as an archive-readiness null, not a modeling failure" — every branch pre-committed; even a pure-memorization judge's Phase 4 is declared informative ("how memorization fails to transfer").

justifications.D1: "A learned model can discover non-obvious feature interactions... that domain rules miss" — permutation null and an ablation exist, but there is no format/template decomposition control, so the surface-learning failure mode from the priors can still bite; guard incomplete.
justifications.D3: "Accuracy floor: FAIL if test accuracy < 58%" plus training-time falsifier abort and a wall-time cap — >=2 numeric falsifiers with stopping rules.
justifications.D4: "Permutation null (label shuffle)... Expected: accuracy drops to ~50% (random)" — at least one confound isolated by design, but the summary's format-only/prior-only decomposition confounds have no concrete design elements.
justifications.D5: "classify whether a new experiment will receive a pass verdict... better than domain heuristics" — a genuinely different question from the refuted attempt-record judge, though the new cell is not explicitly stated against prior work.
justifications.D6: "If (B) achieves >75% accuracy but (A) < 65%, then outcome information is carrying the signal, not design parameter interactions" — falsifier branches map to distinct conclusions, but no vacuous/no-signal reading is pre-committed.
